title: Grateful Dead Live at Starlight Theater on 1982-08-03
source: Aud -> AKG CE1s -> Uher CR240 cassette -> Uher Royal Deluxe 7.5 ips -> Korg MR1000 @24/96 -> AudioGate -> flac level 8; Recorded by Jimi, transferred to digital by CR. AudioGate was used for tracking only.

ai_review.summary: Outstanding analog recording of a strong show, only slightly off‑pitch by about a half step.
ai_review.review: Both reviewers rave about the tape’s superb analog warmth and clarity, calling it an excellent capture of a “really good” performance. The only technical quibble is a minor half‑step slowdown, but overall the recording is highly listenable and the show energetic.

ai_rating.rationale: Two very positive reviews (5★ and 4★) highlight a great performance and high‑quality analog recording, with only a minor speed issue reducing the perfect score.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Warm, clear analog sound; noted to be about a half‑step slow but otherwise crisp and enjoyable.

show_quality.setlist_flow: No specific comments on set structure; reviewers simply note the overall show was very good.
